player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''einnobevoli''') posted a [[Light]] list on DeckTech in November 2001.
description: This deck uses a ton of corvettes and quad laser cannons to totally kick the @#$% of anyone who goes up against me. Don't be too harsh on some of the weird cards in here. It is a third deck made out of all the extra cards I had lying around. Also BTW
notes: Starting cards as posted in 'Starting(3)': Corellia, The Signal, Corellian Engineering Corporation; they count toward the 60.
The post is tagged Light and every card is Light Side; the draft had marked it Dark.
Posted 'Correlia' dested Corellia; 'Kashyyk' dested Kashyyyk; 'Rathal' dested Raithal; 'Collision' dested Collision!.
Posted 'Kiffex' dested the Light Side Kiffex (Jabba's Palace); the A New Hope Kiffex is a Dark Side card.

Posted 'Coruscant' dested the Special Edition Light Coruscant (Force drain +1 here), which fits the strategy's 'heavy draining sites like Kiffex, Coruscant and Kessel'; the other Light printing is Coruscant (Light) (Coruscant).
Posted 'Tatooine' dested the Premiere Light Tatooine; the post does not say which printing (the other is Tatooine (Light) (Coruscant)).
Posted 'Quad Laser Cannon' and 'Combined Attack' are exact card titles (the strategy's 'combined strike' means Combined Attack).
